class MaterialPrefixTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_explicit_embedded_boundary(self):
        raw=fixture(840030);suffix=b'next Property fields'
        self.assertFalse(parse(raw+suffix,840030)['success'])
        prefix=parse(raw+suffix,840030,require_eof=False)
        self.assertTrue(prefix['success']);self.assertEqual(prefix['end'],len(raw))
        self.assertEqual(prefix['reconstruction_sha256'],hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
